thirsty = wanting or needing a drink
appetite = the feeling that you want to eat
portion = the amount of food for one person
buffet = a meal where you serve yourself from many dishes
menu = a list of food you can order in a restaurant
oven = a kitchen box that cooks food with hot air
fridge = a cold cupboard that keeps food fresh
freezer = a very cold box for storing frozen food
microwave = a machine that heats food very quickly
saucepan = a deep pan with a handle for cooking on a hob
frying pan = a flat pan for frying food in a little oil
chopping board = a flat board you cut food on
napkin = a piece of cloth or paper for wiping your mouth
kettle = a container for boiling water
toast = bread cooked until it is brown and crisp
cereal = a breakfast food made from grain, often with milk
porridge = a hot breakfast of oats cooked in milk or water
omelette = eggs mixed and cooked flat in a pan
scrambled eggs = eggs stirred while they cook until they are soft
bacon = salted or smoked meat from a pig, often fried
